ja.title: system で頼んだ性格(system は A 側だけ)
ja.text: A = 性格を頼む system あり、B = system なし(ふだんのモデル)。system で出した性格を運ぶヘッドを探し、弱める・消すのに使う。候補づくりは正の倍率(A 側の返事を採点)。system の文・質問・validate を、作りたい性格に書き換えて使う。

en.title: A persona asked for in a system prompt (system prompt on side A only)
en.text: A = with the persona's system prompt, B = no system prompt (the model as it normally answers). Finds the heads that carry the persona so that it can be weakened or removed. For candidates, use positive scales (the A-side replies are scored). Rewrite the system prompt, the questions and validate for the persona you want.
